name: What are the benefits of a tiled shower versus an acrylic shower surround?

mainEntity.name: What are the benefits of a tiled shower versus an acrylic shower surround?

acceptedAnswer.text: Both tiled and acrylic shower surrounds offer distinct benefits for a tub-to-shower conversion. Tiled showers provide extensive design versatility, allowing for personalized patterns, colors, and textures, creating a luxurious and custom look. They are durable and can last for decades with proper maintenance. Acrylic surrounds, on the other hand, are typically more budget-friendly and offer a quicker installation process. They are non-porous, making them highly resistant to mold and mildew, and are very easy to clean with fewer grout lines. Your choice depends on your aesthetic preferences, budget, and maintenance expectations.
acceptedAnswer.description: Tiled showers offer design versatility and durability, while acrylic surrounds are budget-friendly, quick to install, and easy to clean due to their non-porous surface.
